intro: The Nibbled-On Book is a volume from Northshire Abbey's library recovered from kobold scavengers in Northshire Valley. Bearing the tooth marks of a confused or ravenous creature, it must be returned to Brother Paxton to preserve the abbey's modest collection.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.
Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!
Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?
